title: Genitive roles in a paragraph
subtitle: Compare relationships before choosing a translation.
overview: Repeated genitives can knit a theological paragraph together. They may identify source, possession, description, or a more debated relationship.
Keep a small relationship note beside each genitive rather than translating every one with the same English “of.”

items.en: The word of life was manifested.

items.grc: ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ τετελείωται ἐν αὐτῷ.
items.en: The love of God has been perfected in him; state the relationship before settling translation.
